verdict.rationale: Feitian documents driverless HID operation on Windows, macOS and Linux, Android/iOS support over BLE/NFC/Lightning, and W3C WebAuthn compliance. Its docs site has per-service setup guides for Microsoft/Azure AD, Google Advanced Protection, GitHub/OpenSSH and Windows login, which act as a partial service list. However, there is no evidence of an explicit browser compatibility matrix or a dedicated published catalog of supported services, and all claims are vendor-only. Missing for 10: explicit browser support list, a dedicated published compatibility catalog of supported services, independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-OS/browser behavior.
